high_level_description: This image is a vibrant and imaginative poster for an event titled "INTERNATIONALES DE LA GUITARE En Occitanie." The background features a deep blue sky filled with stars, giving the impression of a night sky or outer space. The setting is whimsical and otherworldly. In the foreground, there is a figure dressed as an astronaut, wearing a red spacesuit with white accents and a helmet. The astronaut is holding a guitar amplifier labeled "iG," which stands for "Internationales de la Guitare." The astronaut appears to be floating amidst clouds, adding to the surreal atmosphere of the scene.
